title: OpenAI launches enterprise agent operations product
verifiedFacts: OpenAI announced Presence for deploying voice and chat agents with approved actions, escalation, evaluations, and changing-policy adaptation.
inference: The competitive center of agent products is shifting from model access toward operational reliability, evaluation, governance, and controlled action.
significance: Validates emphasis on runtime control, evaluation receipts, approval gates, and lifecycle governance.
assumptions: Enterprise adoption will reward governance depth rather than only provider bundling.
knownLimitations: Provider claims do not independently prove adoption, reliability, or buyer outcomes.
